I recently took my 2‑month‑old kitten to Village Vets Tallaght for his first vaccination, and I had a great experience. The vet was extremely friendly, professional, and gentle with my kitten, which immediately put both of us at ease.

The staff were also very welcoming and helpful from the moment we arrived. They took the time to answer my questions and made the whole visit stress-free. It's clear that the team genuinely cares about animals and their wellbeing.

I would highly recommend Village Vets Tallaght to anyone looking for a caring and friendly veterinary practice for their pets. Thank you for taking such good care of my kitten! 🐱🐾
Kind,  caring lovely place for your pet who is ill.
